title: HSK 1.11 · 北京, 汉字, 介绍, 有时候, 东边
focus: 睡 · 四 · 妈 · 谢谢 · 妈妈 · 第二 · 错 · 难 · 跑 · 五 · 远 · 二 · 歌 · 元 · 介绍 · 六 · 唱 · 名字 · 字 · 睡觉 · 第 · 有的 · 南 · 有时候 · 北 · 唱歌 · 北京 · 有用 · 有名 · 西边 · 上边 · 东边 · 南边 · 北边 · 女孩儿 · 下边 · 汉字 · 有一些 · 一下儿
body:
Numbers, compass directions and a run of 有 phrases. 边 turns 东南西北 and 上下 into places, and 有 + a noun makes an adjective (有用, 有名).

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 边 | bian | side | 西边, 上边, 东边, 南边, 北边, 下边 |
| 有 | yǒu | have; there is | 有的, 有时候, 有用, 有名, 有一些 |
| 北 | běi | north (two people back to back) | 北京, 北边 |
| 南 | nán | south | 南边 |
| 字 | zì | character (宀 + 子) | 名字, 汉字 |
| 唱 / 歌 | chàng / gē | sing / song | 唱歌 |
| 第 | dì | (ordinal prefix) | 第二 |
| 一 | yī / yí | one | 有一些, 一下儿 |

## Watch out

- 四 sì (four) vs 西 xī (west): 西 has a line across the top.
- 二 èr is for counting and ordinals (第二); for "two of something" say 两 liǎng.
- 字 zì vs 子 zǐ: 字 adds the 宀 roof.
- 远 yuǎn (far) and its opposite 近 jìn (near) both have 辶.
- 一 changes tone: yí before a 4th tone (一下), yì before others (一些).

cards.Example: 我想睡一会儿。 wǒ xiǎng shuì yíhuìr: I want to sleep a bit.
cards.Notes: 目 eye + 垂 chuí droop (also the sound): drooping eyelids

cards.Example: 我家有四口人。 wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén: There are four of us at home.
cards.Notes: A box 囗 with 儿 inside (an older form was four lines). Lookalike: 西 xī west

cards.Example: 妈，我饿了。 mā, wǒ è le: Mom, I'm hungry.
cards.Notes: 女 woman + 马 mǎ for the sound

cards.Example: 谢谢你的书。 xièxie nǐ de shū: Thanks for the book.
cards.Notes: 谢 = 讠 speech + 射 shè for the sound; doubled, the second one toneless

cards.Example: 妈妈在家。 māma zài jiā: Mom's at home.
cards.Notes: 妈 = 女 woman + 马 mǎ for the sound

cards.Example: 我是第二个。 wǒ shì dì'èr ge: I'm the second one.
cards.Notes: 第 (ordinal prefix) + 二 two = number two in order

cards.Example: 对不起，我错了。 duìbuqǐ, wǒ cuò le: Sorry, I was wrong.
cards.Notes: 钅 metal + 昔 xī for the sound. Lookalike: 借 jiè (borrow) has 亻 instead

cards.Example: 汉字很难写。 Hànzì hěn nán xiě: Chinese characters are hard to write.
cards.Notes: 又 + 隹 short-tailed bird (traditional 難). Also read nàn (disaster) in rarer words

cards.Example: 他跑了! tā pǎo le: He ran off!
cards.Notes: 足 foot + 包 bāo, sound shifted to pǎo

cards.Example: 我五点下课。 wǒ wǔ diǎn xiàkè: I finish class at five.
cards.Notes: An X-like shape between two lines. Lookalike: 王 wáng (king)

cards.Example: 你家远不远？ nǐ jiā yuǎn bu yuǎn: Is your place far?
cards.Notes: 辶 walk + 元 yuán for the sound. Opposite: 近 jìn near

cards.Example: 我要二十个。 wǒ yào èrshí ge: I want twenty.
cards.Notes: Two strokes, the bottom one longer. For 'two of something' use 两 liǎng

cards.Example: 这首歌很好听。 zhè shǒu gē hěn hǎotīng: This song sounds great.
cards.Notes: 哥 gē for the sound + 欠 open mouth: singing

cards.Example: 一共十元。 yígòng shí yuán: Ten yuan in all.
cards.Notes: 二 over 儿: a person with the head marked, so 'head, first'. Written 元 on prices; spoken 块

cards.Example: 我来介绍一下。 wǒ lái jièshào yíxià: Let me introduce.
cards.Notes: 介 be in between + 绍 connect (纟 thread + 召 zhào for the sound) = connect people as a go-between

cards.Example: 我六点起床。 wǒ liù diǎn qǐchuáng: I get up at six.
cards.Notes: 亠 lid over 八. Lookalike: 文 wén (writing)

cards.Example: 她唱得很好。 tā chàng de hěn hǎo: She sings well.
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 昌 chāng for the sound

cards.Example: 这是我的名字。 zhè shì wǒ de míngzi: This is my name.
cards.Notes: 名 = 夕 evening + 口; 字 = 宀 roof + 子 zǐ

cards.Example: 这个字怎么读？ zhège zì zěnme dú: How do you read this character?
cards.Notes: 宀 roof + 子 child (子 zǐ also helps the sound). Compare 子 alone

cards.Example: 他睡觉了。 tā shuìjiào le: He's gone to bed.
cards.Notes: 睡 = 目 eye + 垂 chuí; 觉 is jiào here but jué in 觉得

cards.Example: 我第一次来。 wǒ dì-yī cì lái: It's my first time here.
cards.Notes: ⺮ bamboo + 弟 dì for the sound: bamboo slips kept in order

cards.Example: 有的人不喜欢。 yǒude rén bù xǐhuan: Some people don't like it.
cards.Notes: 有 there are + 的 = those there are: some

cards.Example: 我家在南方。 wǒ jiā zài nánfāng: My home is in the south.
cards.Notes: 十 on top of a frame with 丷 and 干 inside; learn it as one shape. Also in 南京

cards.Example: 我有时候在家吃。 wǒ yǒushíhou zài jiā chī: Sometimes I eat at home.
cards.Notes: 有 there are + 时候 times = there are times: sometimes

cards.Example: 北边很冷。 běibian hěn lěng: It's cold up north.
cards.Notes: Two people back to back (it first meant 'back'); later borrowed for north

cards.Example: 她喜欢唱歌。 tā xǐhuan chànggē: She likes singing.
cards.Notes: 唱 = 口 + 昌 chāng; 歌 = 哥 gē + 欠 (open mouth)

cards.Example: 我去过北京。 wǒ qùguo Běijīng: I've been to Beijing.
cards.Notes: 北 north + 京 capital = northern capital. Compare 南京, the southern capital

cards.Example: 这本书很有用。 zhè běn shū hěn yǒuyòng: This book is really useful.
cards.Notes: 有 have + 用 use = has a use

cards.Example: 他很有名。 tā hěn yǒumíng: He's very famous.
cards.Notes: 有 have + 名 name (夕 evening + 口: calling out a name in the dark) = has a name

cards.Example: 太阳在西边。 tàiyáng zài xībian: The sun is in the west.
cards.Notes: 西 west + 边 side. 西 vs 四: 西 has a line across the top

cards.Example: 书在上边。 shū zài shàngbian: The book is up there.
cards.Notes: 上 up + 边 side = the upper side

cards.Example: 东边是商店。 dōngbian shì shāngdiàn: The shop is on the east side.
cards.Notes: 东 east (traditional 東: sun 日 rising behind a tree 木) + 边 side

cards.Example: 学校在南边。 xuéxiào zài nánbian: The school is to the south.
cards.Notes: 南 south + 边 side

cards.Example: 北边下雪了。 běibian xiàxuě le: It's snowing up north.
cards.Notes: 北 north + 边 side

cards.Example: 那个女孩儿是谁？ nàge nǚháir shì shéi: Who's that girl?
cards.Notes: 女 woman + 孩 child (子 + 亥 hài for the sound) + 儿 -r

cards.Example: 猫在桌子下边。 māo zài zhuōzi xiàbian: The cat is under the table.
cards.Notes: 下 down + 边 side = the lower side

cards.Example: 我会写一百个汉字。 wǒ huì xiě yìbǎi ge Hànzì: I can write a hundred characters.
cards.Notes: 汉 Han Chinese + 字 character = characters of the Han

cards.Example: 有一些人走了。 yǒu yìxiē rén zǒu le: Some people have left.
cards.Notes: 有 there are + 一些 a few = there are some; also 'somewhat' (有一些累)

cards.Example: 你等一下儿。 nǐ děng yíxiàr: Wait a moment.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 下 go, time + 儿 = one go: do briefly. 一 is yí before a 4th tone
